{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Sheath dress, knee-length, deep emerald green (#0a3d32), silk charmeuse with a subtle satin sheen.
Gold-and-black beaded choker necklace, delicate chain with a small pendant.
Drop-earrings, polished gold hoops with pearl accents.
Elegant pumps, pointed-toe, metallic bronze finish, suede interior.
Why this outfit works: This ensemble strikes the perfect balance for an upscale summer wedding in August, offering the formality required by the occasion while remaining cool and comfortable in warm weather. The rich emerald green complements her warm skin tone beautifully, creating a sophisticated yet vibrant look that stands out without overshadowing the bride. The silk fabric adds a luxurious texture suitable for a restaurant setting, while the heel provides necessary elegance to match the dress code."}
